# Non-REAPER Workspace Surface prototype fixture

This fixture drives the Group 1 `wt demo` path through the production generic
registry, catalog, frame, bridge, broker, and modal seams. It is not yet an
installable plugin: Group 2 adds strict manifest/install/artifact handling and
then promotes the validated fixture to `examples/plugins/workspace-surface-demo/`.

Launch it only in the isolated sandbox:

```bash
./scripts/demo-workspace-surface.sh 8931
```
